### Problem Description
A clear and concise description of what the issue or deprecation is.

### Affected Area
- [ ] Core HTML / Meta Tags (`index.html` / `404.html`)
- [ ] Corporate Stylesheet (`css/style.css` / `css/style.min.css`)
- [ ] JavaScript Application Engine (`js/main.js` / `js/main.min.js`)
- [ ] PWA & Offline Service Worker (`sw.js` / `assets/site.webmanifest`)
- [ ] Versioning & Date Synchronization (`data/version.json` / `sync-version.js`)
- [ ] Schema & Data Profiles (`data/schema.json` / `llms.txt`)

### Steps to Reproduce
1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '....'
3. Scroll down to '....'
4. See error or warning in DevTools console

### Expected Behavior
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

### Environment
- OS: [e.g. Windows 11, Android 14, iOS 18]
- Browser: [e.g. Chrome 130, Safari 18, Firefox 131]
- Version: [e.g. v26.11.02.1]
